checks.title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
checks.rationale: Remote root login increases the impact of credential guessing.

checks.title: Ensure SSH idle timeout is configured
checks.rationale: Idle sessions left open can be reused by another person.

checks.title: Ensure SSH protocol uses strong ciphers only
checks.rationale: Weak ciphers allow traffic to be decrypted if captured.

checks.title: Ensure password minimum length is at least 14
checks.rationale: Short passwords are easier to guess.

checks.title: Ensure account lockout after failed logins
Ensure unused filesystems are disabled
checks.rationale: Unneeded modules enlarge the attack surface.

checks.title: Ensure /tmp is a separate partition
checks.rationale: A separate /tmp can restrict execution and space exhaustion.

checks.title: Ensure time synchronization is in use
Ensure the firewall service is active
Ensure auditd is installed
checks.rationale: Without audit records some investigations lack evidence.

checks.title: Ensure legacy NIS client is not installed
Ensure wireless interfaces are disabled
checks.rationale: Servers without radios cannot use this exposure.

checks.title: Ensure Bluetooth service is disabled
checks.rationale: Servers without radios cannot use this exposure.

checks.title: Ensure core dumps are restricted
checks.rationale: Core dumps may contain sensitive memory contents.

checks.title: Ensure sticky bit is set on world-writable directories
checks.rationale: Prevents users from deleting others' files.

checks.title: Ensure GRUB bootloader password is set
checks.rationale: Check depends on physical-access scope not defined for this VM.
checks.observed: Virtual machine; console access governed by hypervisor
